title: The Council of Rome
summary: Rome, Lent 2770. The Church sits in council on the new machines and the new creatures. That night the city burns, the specimens break loose and the automata go wrong: the King holds the bridges until dawn.

sides.name: The Crown
sides.about: The young King, his guard and Father Tomasz, Rome's garrison on the east bank, the Swiss at Saint Peter's.

sides.name: The Creatures
sides.about: The Academy's specimens, loose from their stables by the Porta del Popolo.

sides.name: The Automata
sides.about: Meister Hollweg's demonstration pieces, out of the exhibition hall and winding each other.

sides.name: The Assembly's Last Cell
sides.about: The Free Assembly's last torch-bearers in Rome.

objectives.text: Hold the three bridges: nothing of the creatures or the machines may reach Saint Peter's Square.
The people: Father Tomasz (or a Missionary) calls each quarter to Saint Peter's. Saved: {saved} of {saved.of}.
Put out the fires: men standing by a burning house put it out. A fire left alone spreads.
Cross the river: bring three of your creatures into Saint Peter's Square before dawn.
Cross the river: bring three of your machines into Saint Peter's Square before dawn.

k_open1.text: Rome, Lent 2770. I was young, three years crowned. This one I tell myself: it was my city.

k_open2.text: The Church sat in council on the new machines and the new creatures. I sat with the cardinals and listened.

f_pattern.text: Meister Hollweg's own drawings, Eminences. The machine at Nuremberg was drawn to build its own successor.

f_people.text: My report from Nuremberg, Eminences. Drawings or no drawings, the machine went on building itself.

f_quarrel.text: I told him the night before the gift. The ghost in the machine destroyed the apostasy once. It was the enemy then. It is the enemy now.

v_drawn.text: I drew the way up the plateau for the Crown. I saw her there, the creature from the station, grown, among her own.

v_withheld.text: I gave my map to the Church alone, sealed. But I saw her there, the creature from the station, grown, among her own.

k_hollweg_rung.text: Meister Hollweg came as a witness. Nuremberg's bells had rung on his word, and he had saved what he could.

k_hollweg_quiet.text: Meister Hollweg came as one accused. He had kept the bells of Nuremberg quiet.

h_brass.text: My machines are not the ghost of the old age, Eminences. They are brass and springs. They could learn.

k_eggs_told.text: The eggs were no secret. Lieutenant Teles had written to the Crown about the station.

k_eggs_found.text: Under questioning it came out: Dr. Lindqvist had saved the eggs from the fire, and told no one.

k_eggs_ashes.text: Dr. Lindqvist said the eggs were ashes. It was true.

l_oldest.text: They are not monsters, Eminences. They are the oldest things alive. Study them, and you read a page of creation no one has read.

k_varenne_spared.text: A letter from Varenne in exile was read out. He condemned any fire set in his name.

k_varenne_exec.text: Varenne was dead a year. His last friends in Rome had not forgotten.

c_verdict1.text: No machine may govern itself. Every machine that winds or mends itself shall be stopped and broken.

c_verdict2.text: The specimens are to be destroyed, and their eggs with them.

h_defy.text: Then you have judged what you will not understand. I will not break my life's work.

l_defy.text: Burn them, and you burn a page of God's own book. I will not.

k_letgo.text: They both walked out of the hall. I let them go. My mercy, or my mistake: I still don't know.

n_walkout.text: Meister Hollweg goes to his exhibition hall; Dr. Lindqvist to his stables.

k_1.text: I sent my guard to the bridges that evening. I did not know why. I only knew the city was angry.

t_1.text: Majesty, the Romans were at the doors all day. They hate a clever machine more than they hate the devil.

k_tip_bridges.text: Three bridges: Ripetta in the north, Sant'Angelo under the castle, Sisto in the south. The garrison holds their east ends.

n_fire1.text: Fire in the Campo Marzio. The Assembly's last cell has come to Rome.

k_2.text: The bells rang all over the city. Then the second fire, and the third.

n_cell_spared.text: Only a few torch-bearers: half the cell walked away after Varenne's letter.

n_cell_exec.text: They burn Rome for Varenne: more torches, and their muskets at the bridges.

n_torch.text: Torch-bearers in by the Porta Pia.

t_people.text: The people are in the squares, Majesty, waiting for someone to tell them where to go. Let me go to them.

tip_church.text: Santo Spirito trains Missionaries. Any priest can call a quarter to Saint Peter's, not only Tomasz.

tip_fire.text: A fire left alone takes the next house. Men standing by a burning house put it out.

t_call.text: Come! To Saint Peter's, all of you, over the bridge. Stay together.

n_flee.text: The people run from the machines and the beasts, for the bridges, with no one to lead them.

n_smoke.text: Their houses are burning: the people of a quarter make for the river by themselves.

n_saved.text: The first of the people reach the steps of Saint Peter's.

n_loose.text: The stables by the Porta del Popolo are open. The specimens are loose in the streets.

l_loose.text: Not like this! They are frightened. Let them be!

n_demo.text: In the exhibition hall Hollweg's demonstration has woken. The pieces wind each other and walk out.

h_demo.text: Stop! I mended them! I put the stop-works back with my own hands!

n_demo_melted.text: Hollweg had brought only two pieces, to show the stop-work. In the smoke they start, and do not stop.

h_demo_melted.text: The stop-work holds! It must hold. Why does it not hold?

k_machine_own.text: Two of his pieces were not his at all. They were the Machine's, from the Fürth meadows.

n_mob.text: In the Piazza Navona the Romans turn on the machines with pikes and stones.

n_meet.text: Beasts and machines meet in the streets of Parione, and fall on each other.

k_meet.text: Let them. Every one they kill is one fewer at my bridges.

k_3.text: Hold the bridges until dawn. Nothing crosses to Saint Peter's.

t_3.text: The basilica's doors are open, Majesty. Everyone who reaches them is safe.

n_rain.text: Rain before dawn. The fires that are left begin to die.

n_crossed.text: They are in Saint Peter's Square.

k_dawn.text: Dawn. The bridges held. Rome was black with smoke, and it was still Rome.

t_dawn.text: They are singing Lauds in the basilica, Majesty. With the doors open.

t_king.text: The King is hit! Guard, to the King!

k_priest.text: Keep the Father behind the line. Rome needs its priests tonight.

cr_1.text: The pens will open when the fire comes. Cross the river to the great square before the light.

au_1.text: The hall's doors will open when the fire comes. Wind each other. Cross the river to the great square before the light.

k_end1.text: The verdict stood. The machines in the Papal States were stopped, and the specimens we found were destroyed.

k_end_rome_all.text: Every quarter of Rome stood. I was prouder of that than of anything I did that year.

k_end_rome_some.text: Some of Rome burned. We rebuilt it that summer, street by street.

k_end_rome_few.text: Most of the east bank burned. Rome rebuilt it, and has not forgotten.

t_end_people.text: We counted them on the steps in the morning, and wrote down every name.

k_end_defiance.text: Hollweg and Lindqvist were gone by morning: Hollweg after his crates, south; Lindqvist to breed what was left, in secret.

k_end2.text: That was the first time I met them both. It was not the last.

k_end_lost1.text: That is not how it went. They never reached the square.

k_end_lost2.text: But if they had, there would have been no council, and no Church to hold one.

new_church.text: NEW: THE CHURCH. Rome's churches train Missionaries.

new_missionary.text: NEW: THE MISSIONARY. He brings the fallen back and leads the people where a soldier can't.

council.caption: Rome, Lent 2770. The council in session.

accused.caption: Meister Hollweg and Dr. Lindqvist before the council.

text: Rome, Lent 2770. The council gives its verdict on the machines and the creatures, and that night the city burns.
Hold the three bridges until dawn: nothing of the loose creatures or the runaway machines may reach Saint Peter's Square. They fight each other too.
Send Father Tomasz (and the Missionaries of Santo Spirito, new) to call the people of the east bank to the basilica, and put out the fires.
The King and Father Tomasz must live.
Rome, Lent 2770. You are the Academy's specimens, penned in the stables by the Porta del Popolo.
When the fire comes the pens open. Bring three of your creatures into Saint Peter's Square before dawn. The machines are loose too.
Rome, Lent 2770. You are Meister Hollweg's demonstration pieces in the exhibition hall.
When the fire comes the doors open. Keep wound, and bring three of your machines into Saint Peter's Square before dawn. The beasts are loose too.

crown.title: Rome holds
crown.text: The bridges held until dawn. Saved on the steps of Saint Peter's: {saved}.

text_if.text: Most of the east bank burned.

creatures.title: The creatures cross the Tiber
creatures.text: The beasts are in Saint Peter's Square.

automata.text: The automata are in Saint Peter's Square.
